audit_items.proof_trace: The property asserts commitment deduplication must preserve semantic equivalence, but the implementation does not perform any deduplication. The kzg.Verify and VerifyBlobKZGProofBatch functions pass all commitments directly to the underlying cryptographic library without preprocessing. While this is inefficient for duplicate commitments, it does not violate correctness since verifying duplicates multiple times yields the same result as verifying once.
